req.title: Return 404 for unknown squadNumber
req.statement: The system shall return HTTP 404 when no player has the requested squad number.

doc.reasoning: The violation was test[5] having kind=negative but heuristic=EP. Negative tests must use NEG (or DT) heuristic, not EP (which is reserved for positive equivalence partitions). Fix: change test[5] heuristic from EP to NEG, which correctly classifies it as a negative equivalence partition for an unknown squad number. All other tests are preserved unchanged.

tests.name: test_known_squad_number_returns_200_not_404
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 players, squad numbers 1-26
Squad number 10 (Messi) exists in the database
expected: Response body contains squadNumber 10 and lastName Messi
trace: R-PLAYER-005: confirms the 404 path is NOT triggered for a known squad number, killing mutations that always return 404 or invert the not-found condition
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_known_squad_number_returns_200_not_404():
    r = client.get('/players/squadnumber/10')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 10
    assert body['lastName'] == 'Messi'
    assert body['firstName'] == 'Lionel'

test_known_squad_number_returns_200_not_404()

def test_gap_squad_number_between_seeded_values_returns_404():

    assert r.status_code == 404
    assert 'application/json' in r.headers.get('content-type', '')
